title: Survey agreement share gauge
intent: Show the observed agreement share for one question in Observable Plot's Likert survey across a 270-degree annular sweep.

ai.create: Reduce the survey's raw Question and Response rows to an agreement percentage, then create a 270-degree gauge from that observed share and its remainder using two keyed annular arcs.
ai.maintain: Change the selected question while preserving the visible reducer, partial sweep, zero baseline, responsive radii, stable agreement and remainder identities, and exact fills.
